video_title: Watch Melo Hoop & Tell Us How Much He’d Average in the NBA Right Now

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the competitive nature of pickup basketball
quotes.excerpt: There's guys in the city that probably still think that they can fuck with you.
quotes.quote: There's guys in the city that probably still think that they can fuck with you, no matter what you've ever achieved. That's in the hood. That's just talking shit to you here. But they are all my guys that come through the program. We bring them back, we play, the younger kids had practice. We made it something. I just like to have fun. It's basketball, bro. When I left the game, I wasn't broken physically. I had a great year with the Lakers in that role. I still was in basketball form, not shape. I still can play the game of basketball.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the importance of physical maintenance for older players
quotes.excerpt: Once you're over 40, core and back is important. If your hips right, your ankles right.
quotes.quote: Once you're over 40, core and back is important. Need that. Hips, core, back is important, okay? Fuck all that heavy lifting and shit. Get your core, get your back, get your hips right. If your hips right, your ankles right. If your ankles right, your knees right. You understand what I'm saying? It's important. Do it on Fridays. Beach workout on Fridays. Every day of the week, get the essentials. When you're 40 and over, hips, core, back, ankles. All right?

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on his preference for private training sessions
quotes.excerpt: I love this. I'll do it my own program. I'll do it with my kids.
quotes.quote: I got Juju right there. He's in the NBA right now. No, I love this. I'll do it my own program. I'll do it with my kids. But once you start getting all the other guys just want to be hyped to be in the gym and play, I ain't with that. Because I don't know how to turn it off. And I don't want to hurt myself. I'm 40, I'm 42, I don't want to hurt myself.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on his skill-based approach to pickup games
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to my skill set with those guys. So my skill set will cherish.
quotes.quote: Put me in the gym with the best guys. I'm going to my skill set with those guys. I'm not trying to outshine those guys. I'm going to my skill set with those guys. So my skill set with those guys in the open gym will cherish. Because in the game where we trying to get to seven, y'all can go get the five or six, we going to need a bucket. And we going to need a bucket from here. We ain't trying to shoot no three. We going to get a bucket from here, so you going to rely on my skill set.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on his competitive drive in the gym
quotes.excerpt: I'm not walking in the gym and just being cool. I compete if I'm in the gym.
quotes.quote: I love the game of basketball, but I love to compete. I love to play. I love to see like people around me like having a good time playing basketball. But I also, I'm a competitor. So I compete if I'm in the gym. I compete. I'm not walking in the gym and just being cool. I don't know how to do that.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on maintaining his competitive level
quotes.excerpt: The level of competition that come in the gym, it forces you to rise your level.
quotes.quote: I think I will always do that. Whether it's young, old, whatever, I will always do that. Now, the level of competition that come in the gym, it forces you to rise your level of competition. That's all I'm saying. And I don't want to go back into that. I just want to have fun and shoot, have court threes and shit. Hesy pulls. I want to still work on my one-dribble pull-up.
